name: Juice Shop v3.1: Cauchy fusion and exact multi-source attack confirmation
registered: 2026-11-26, after the v3 Juice Shop test (run 45913538168, inconclusive) and before any v3.1 session ran
relation_to_v3: The v3 test stands as recorded: inconclusive, 9 of 10 confirmed, 0.26% benign alerts. Its two lessons drive the only two changes here. v3.1 is a new design measured in fresh sessions; the v3 result is not revised.
change_1_fusion: The registered detector combines the four component tail probabilities with the Cauchy combination test (Liu and Xie, JASA 2020): T = mean of tan((0.5 - p_j) pi) with each p_j clipped to [1e-12, 0.5], so an unremarkable component (p >= 0.5) contributes exactly zero; uncapped, a p near 1 adds a large negative term that would cancel a strong signal (found by the unit test before any run). Under Fisher's method, a single never-seen request (p about 1/1051) could not reach the threshold once noisy benign responses raised it to 25.7; under Cauchy combination one very small p can carry the decision. Everything else is unchanged: components, profiles, forest, 40/35/25 splits, 0.5% budget. Fisher's statistic is reported beside it on the same session.
change_2_confirmation: A confirmed attack is a recorded attack exchange matched exactly by any of three sources fixed in confirm.py: (a) zap: the request ZAP stored for a Medium or High alert raised by an active-scan rule, fetched from ZAP's message API by the alert's messageId, equal in method, request target and body; (b) challenge: a Juice Shop challenge whose solved timestamp falls within an attack exchange's forward/response window, plus or minus 50 ms; (c) sqlmap: an sqlmap request whose decoded target or body contains a payload sqlmap printed as confirmed. Family = the ZAP scan rule's family, the challenge category, or SQL injection for sqlmap.
sessions: Fresh development session of 3000 benign requests (seed 2026112904), frozen. One fresh test session (benign seed 2026112905): ZAP seeded and active scan for at most 40 minutes, then sqlmap at level 3, risk 2, against product search, login and order tracking, at most 15 minutes each.
pass_condition: For the Cauchy-fused detector: (1) at most 1% of benign test requests alert; (2) at least 90% of confirmed attacks alert. If fewer than 30 confirmed attacks exist, or they come from fewer than 2 families, the outcome is inconclusive.
known_limits: Benign traffic is generated. The design change was informed by the v3 Juice Shop session. Confirmation depends on what ZAP, Juice Shop's challenge tracker and sqlmap can confirm; attempts they cannot confirm are reported, not scored.
